create.title: Create organization

create.slug_later: You can change the workspace URL later in the organization settings.

invitations.title: Inbox
invitations.general_empty_description: General updates about your account and organizations will appear here.

invitations.error_description: We could not load this inbox. Try again in a moment.

invitations.mismatch_description: Sign in with the email address that received the invitation. Organization details stay hidden until the email matches.
invitations.empty_description: There are no active invitations for your verified email.

settings.organization_description: Manage the organization name and workspace URL.
settings.team_description: Review current members and manage access to this organization.

profile.title: Organization profile
profile.description: These details identify the organization throughout OpenStream.
profile.readonly_description: Members can view organization details. Only the Owner can edit them.
profile.slug_change_description: Existing links using the current slug will stop working.
profile.slug_change_warning: The old URL becomes available for another organization immediately. OpenStream does not create a redirect.

team.members_description: The roster shows each member's name, email, and role.
team.name: Name
team.leave_description: Your access is revoked immediately and this frees one membership slot.
team.leave_dialog_description: You will immediately lose access to {{organization}}.
team.invitations_description: Invite Members and manage pending or recently expired invitations.
team.error_description: We could not load the organization roster.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Sensitive changes take effect immediately or disable the organization.
danger.transfer_description: Choose an existing Member. They become Owner immediately and you become a Member.
danger.transfer_dialog_description: Select the new Owner and type the exact organization name to confirm.
danger.transfer_warning: The role change is atomic and does not require the recipient to accept.
danger.delete_description: Disable the organization now and permanently delete every scoped record after four days.
danger.delete_dialog_description: This action disables the organization immediately. Both confirmation values are case-sensitive.
danger.delete_email_explanation: The Owner receives an email with “Cancel deletion” and “Delete instantly” actions. Both links require the authenticated current Owner.

pending.title: {{organization}} is pending deletion
pending.description: Normal organization use and membership changes are frozen during the four-day recovery window.
pending.restore_description: Canceling reactivates the workspace and invalidates both email action links.
pending.cancel_dialog_description: {{organization}} will become active immediately and both email action links will be invalidated.
pending.owner_only: Only the current Owner can cancel deletion.

deletion_action.title: Organization deletion action
deletion_action.description: Your authenticated Owner session and the single-use email token are both being verified.
deletion_action.cancel_success: The organization is active again and both email links are now invalid.
deletion_action.delete_success: The organization and all organization-scoped data were permanently deleted.
deletion_action.error_description: The link is invalid, expired, already used, or this account is not the current Owner.

not_found.title: Organization unavailable
not_found.description: This URL is no longer valid or your account does not have access.
